drivingQuestion: What does the word rav in the verse about the destroying angel signify?
outcomeNote: A single homiletic reading of one word, with its narrative outcome; nothing is contested.

segments.he: ״וַיֹּאמֶר לַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית בָּעָם רַב״. אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: אֲמַר לֵיהּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְמַלְאָךְ: טוֹל לִי רַב שֶׁבָּהֶם, שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ לִיפָּרַע מֵהֶם כַּמָּה חוֹבוֹת. בְּאוֹתָהּ שָׁעָה מֵת אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן צְרוּיָה, שֶׁשָּׁקוּל כְּרוּבָּהּ שֶׁל סַנְהֶדְרִין.
segments.en: It is also stated there: “The Lord repented Him of the evil «and said to the angel that destroyed the many [rav] people:» It is enough; now stay your hand” (II Samuel 24:16). Explaining the meaning of the word rav, «Rabbi Elazar said» that «the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to the angel: Take for me a great one [rav] from among them, who is worthy of defraying several» of Israel’s «debts.» As a result, «at that moment Avishai ben Tzeruya, who was equivalent to the majority of the Sanhedrin, died.» His death atoned for the entire nation.
